title: EU/UK deletion SLA + subprocessor attestation pilot and retention-tier pricing toggle
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Enterprise prospects (legal and security teams) are requesting a contractual deletion SLA, clearer subprocessor attestations, and a predictable pricing model that reflects explicit retention and residency commitments for EU/UK data. Current playbooks and self-serve contract flows do not let customers opt into a deletion SLA or attach quarterly subprocessor attestation reports.

Proposal: Run a pilot that implements three coordinated pieces: (1) a self-serve contract toggle 'EU/UK: 30-day deletion SLA + SCCs' in the contract configurator that, when enabled, adds a clause committing to a 30 calendar-day hard-delete timeline for customer data stored in EU/UK regions and auto-appends the appropriate SCC references; (2) a subprocessor attestation add-on where Redwood will provide quarterly attestation artifacts (digest + list of subprocessors + SOC-lite checklist) available through the Contract Console and the onboarding Data Transfer Annex; (3) a retention-tier pricing experiment that creates an add-on SKU (retention-tier-eu-1) priced as a percent uplift to base usage to cover storage and compliance costs.

Goals:
- Validate that customers are willing to pay for explicit deletion and attestation guarantees (target: 3 pilot customers signed in Q2).
- Measure incremental MRR impact and average uplift per customer.
- Verify operational runbook: deletion jobs, e-discovery hold override, KMS key handling, audit trail.

Success metrics: 
- 3 enterprise pilots signed by 2025-04-15.
- <2 operational incidents in pilot related to deletion correctness.
- Pricing uplift >= 7% on average for customers who select the toggle.

Non-goals / constraints:
- This pilot does NOT include on-prem deployments (Private) — scope limited to Hosted + Dedicated EU/UK regions.
- We will not extend to global rights deletions or comply with country-specific special legislation beyond EU/UK SCC references.

Key trade-offs considered: 
- Deletion SLA window: 30 vs 90 days. 30d is aggressive and market-competitive; it requires more automation and stronger assurances around backup retention. 90d is operationally easier but less attractive to security teams. We chose 30d for pilot to maximize customer signal.
- Level of attestation artifacts: full SOC reports are expensive; offering a quarterly attestation digest (attestation of subprocessors + checklist of controls) strikes balance between effort and customer trust.
- Pricing model: flat monthly fee vs percent uplift. Percent uplift scales with usage and better reflects unit economics for heavy token customers, so we propose percent uplift for the experiment.

Operational requirements:
- Add a contract clause template in Confluence + legal must approve final wording (link below).
- Engineering work: deletion pipeline hard-delete path, e-discovery hold flag, region-aware deletion queue, KMS key rotation mapping. Estimated ENG work: 5 sprint points across ENG infra and data-platform.
- Console changes: contract configurator toggle, UI for attestation artifacts download, billing SKU mapping.
- Telemetry: new dashboard capturing toggle opt-ins, SLA compliance events, deletion queue lag, and cost uplift.

Risk & mitigation:
- Risk: accidental early deletion due to bug. Mitigation: require two-step confirmation for hard-delete runs, pre-run dry-run reports, and canary on a single customer first.
- Risk: legal pushback on wording. Mitigation: partner with Legal for templated clause and fallback language (90d) if negotiation needed.

Deliverables:
- Contract clause template (Confluence).
- Console toggle + attestation artifacts page + billing SKU.
- Eng runbook + rollback playbook.
- Pilot onboarding checklist and post-pilot evaluation doc.
acceptance_criteria: Legal-approved clause template added to Confluence and linked from the Contract Console
Console toggle visible in contract configurator for EU/UK with tooltip explaining guarantees
Quarterly attestation artifacts are uploadable and downloadable from Console (pilot customers only)
Billing SKU 'retention-tier-eu-1' created and mapped to toggle in billing system
Deletion pipeline passes end-to-end canary tests for one internal test tenant with audit trail
Telemetry dashboard shows toggle opt-ins and SLA compliance events with <1 hour ingestion lag
